route.prompt_template:
Graphic design poster. Headline text reads exactly "{headline}".
Typeface feel: {type_style}. Layout: {layout}.
Palette: {palette}. Graphic elements: {elements}.
Text must be spelled correctly and fully legible.

attempts.prompt:
Graphic design poster, mid-century modern jazz club style, flat vector shapes with a subtle risograph ink texture on off-white paper.
Headline text reads exactly "MIDNIGHT SET" in a heavy condensed display typeface, filling the upper half of the poster.
Secondary line reads exactly "LIVE AT THE BLUE ROOM". Small caption block at the bottom reads exactly "FRIDAY 11PM".
Typeface feel: bold geometric sans, tight letter spacing, high contrast against the background.
Layout: vertical 2:3, headline dominating the top half, a saxophone reduced to cut-paper geometric shapes laid diagonally across the middle, small caption block bottom-left, wide margins.
Palette: exactly three colors — vermillion #E8452C, bone #F0E5D0, near-black #131313.
Graphic elements: flat solid shapes only, no outlines, no shading.
Text must be spelled correctly and fully legible.

Avoid: misspelled text, garbled letters, cropped words, cluttered hierarchy, gradients, 3d bevel, drop shadow, photographic elements, overlapping text.
attempts.critique: 타이포 포스터에서 가장 잘 터지는 철자 오류가 전혀 없다. MIDNIGHT SET, LIVE AT THE BLUE ROOM, FRIDAY 11PM 세 줄 모두 정확하고 잘림도 없다. 색을 정확히 3색으로 지킨 점, 리소그래프 잉크 결이 살아있는 점이 레퍼런스와 일치. 감점은 색소폰 벨이 오른쪽 여백을 침범해 마진이 불균등하고, 두 번째 줄이 악기 몸통과 살짝 겹치는 부분.
attempts.fix: 색소폰을 5퍼센트 축소해 오른쪽 마진을 헤드라인과 맞추고, 두 번째 줄을 악기와 겹치지 않게 아래로 내릴 것.
